changeSet.author: sondos
changeSet.sql: CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW reports.vwconsultation AS SELECT c.id, c.patient_id, c.encounter_id, c.from_facility_id, c.to_facility_id, c.from_department_id, c.to_department_id, c.consultation_number, c.destination_type, c.consultation_type, c.consultant_speciality, c.consultation_method, c.practitioner_id, c.consultation_level, c.consultation_content, c.notes, c.extra_document, c.approval_number, c.status, c.cancelled_date, c.cancelled_by, c.cancellation_reason, c.response_date, c.response_by, c.response_text, c.rejected_date, c.rejected_by, c.reject_reason, c.confirmed_date, c.confirmed_by, c.submitted_date, c.submitted_by, c.created_by, c.created_date, c.last_modified_by, c.last_modified_date FROM public.consultation c;

changeSet.author: sondos
changeSet.sql: GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA reports TO report_user;
GRANT SELECT ON reports.vwconsultation TO report_user;

rollback.sql: REVOKE SELECT ON reports.vwconsultation FROM report_user;
